title: "Kantsoner mellom vei og natur"
author: "Jenny Hansen"
format: html
editor: visual
---

Load required libraries

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(mapview)

```

Import data

```{r echo=FALSE}

# veier
veier <- st_read("/data/R/GeoSpatialData/Topography/Norway_N50/Original/N50 Kartdata FGDB-format/Basisdata_32_Akershus_25832_N50Kartdata_FGDB/Basisdata_32_Akershus_25832_N50Kartdata_FGDB.gdb", layer = "N50_Samferdsel_senterlinje") %>% 
  filter(typeveg == "enkelBilveg") %>% 
  mutate(road_id = row_number()) # assign unique id (missing objectid)

# natural land cover (arealtype is skog, åpenfastmark, myr or ferskvann)
natur <- st_read("/data/R/GeoSpatialData/Topography/Norway_FKB/Original/FKB-AR5 FGDB-format/Basisdata_32_Akershus_25832_FKB-AR5_FGDB.gdb", layer = "fkb_ar5_omrade") %>% 
  filter(arealtype %in% c("30", "50", "60", "81"))


# Canopy Height Model classification was done in Google Earth Engine:
# https://code.earthengine.google.com/bae90ed14775ac4adac711981634e6e4

chm_bin <- rast("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/akershus_chm_binary_10m.tif")
```

Find road segments that overlap natural land cover types

```{r echo=FALSE}

# buffer natural areas by 10 m
natur_buf <- natur %>% st_buffer(10)

# intersect with roads
vei_nat_part <- st_intersection(veier, natur_buf)

vei_nat_len <- vei_nat_part %>%
  mutate(len_nat = st_length(.)) %>%
  group_by(road_id) %>%  
  summarise(len_nat = sum(len_nat))

# get total length of all roads
vei_total_len <- veier %>%
  mutate(len_total = st_length(.)) %>%
  select(road_id, len_total)

# proportion of road along nature
vei_prop <- vei_total_len %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  left_join(vei_nat_len %>% st_drop_geometry(), by = "road_id") %>%
  mutate(len_nat = ifelse(is.na(len_nat), 0, len_nat),
         prop_nat = as.numeric(len_nat) / as.numeric(len_total))

# filter for segments with at least 75% natural
veier_sel <- veier %>%
  left_join(vei_prop, by = "road_id") %>%
  filter(prop_nat >= 0.75)

# buffer remaining segments by 20 m
veier_buf <- veier_sel %>% st_buffer(20)

```

Find areas that overlap CHM raster with '1' values- less than 2 m vegetation

```{r echo=FALSE}

veier_natur_vect <- vect(veier_buf)

# get proportion of cells with <= 2 m vegetation
veier_natur_vect$veg_low_prop <- extract(chm_bin, veier_natur_vect, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)[,2]

# filter for those that are at least 75% low vegetation
veier_sel <- veier_natur_vect %>% st_as_sf() %>% filter(veg_low_prop > 0.75)
mapview(veier_sel, zcol = "veg_low_prop") 

# write to scratch temporarily and copy to P drive
out_gpkg <- "/data/scratch/tmp_jenny/gpkg/kantsoner_vei_natur.gpkg"
st_write(veier_sel, out_gpkg, layer = "kantsoner_vei_natur")


file.copy(
  from = out_gpkg,
  to = "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Kriteriekart/kantsoner_vei_natur.gpkg",
  overwrite = TRUE)
```
